answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique road tax payment record flips the bet — tax paid on the same vehicle for a decade — and the ocean lands on the attacker instead. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since tax paid on the same vehicle for a decade takes calendar time as well as money — and the sable is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the wharf of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
